name: Production Session
summary: Bring the track you’re stuck on and fix it together.
tagline: Fix the track you’re stuck on.

photos.alt: Candy Heist working the decks under crimson stage light

overview: Bring a project you’re stuck on. We open it up together, fix what’s holding it back, and you learn every move along the way.
You drive in your own DAW while Candy Heist works through it with you over a shared screen: the arrangement, the sound design, the mixdown, whatever the track needs most.

howItRuns.title: Listen through
howItRuns.text: The track top to bottom, and where you want it to go.

howItRuns.title: Work on it together
howItRuns.text: Arrangement, sound design, the mixdown. You drive, he guides.

howItRuns.title: Walk through the changes
howItRuns.text: What changed and why, so you can do it alone next time.

howItRuns.title: Next steps
howItRuns.text: What to try before the next session.

goodFor: A track that’s most of the way there and won’t finish
Learning a technique on your own music, not a tutorial’s
A trained second pair of ears on a mix
bring: Your project, open and ready to share
The part you most want to fix

name: DJ Lessons
summary: From your first blend to reading a room.
tagline: From first blend to full set.

photos.alt: Candy Heist mid-set, headphones on, hands on the mixer

overview: Learn to DJ on your gear or his, from the first beatmatch to building a set that reads the room.
Lessons are paced to you. Beginners start with the fundamentals; working DJs bring the parts of their sets they want to push further.
included: In Halifax or live over video
A practice plan for the week after

howItRuns.title: Warm up
howItRuns.text: Where you are, and what you want to be able to do.

howItRuns.title: Technique
howItRuns.text: Beatmatching, phrasing and transitions, one at a time.

howItRuns.title: Play it out
howItRuns.text: A short set of your own, with notes as you go.

howItRuns.title: Practice plan
howItRuns.text: Exactly what to drill before the next lesson.

goodFor: Complete beginners who want the fundamentals right
DJs moving from bedroom sets to real rooms
Anyone preparing for a first gig
bring: Your controller, if you have one
A handful of tracks you love

name: Project Feedback
summary: Honest notes on your track, with a video walkthrough.

photos.alt: The laptop on Candy Heist’s booth, covered in stickers

overview: Send a track and get clear, honest notes on the arrangement, the mixdown and the sound design, with a video walkthrough of the fixes that matter most.
The time you pick is a short call to go through the notes together, so nothing is left unclear.
included: A video walkthrough of the key fixes
A short call to go through them

howItRuns.title: Send the track
howItRuns.text: A bounce, plus the project if you want notes on it.

howItRuns.title: Listen and write up
howItRuns.text: Point-by-point notes and a video of the key fixes.

howItRuns.title: Go through them
howItRuns.text: A short call at the time you pick, for any questions.

goodFor: A finished track before you send it out
Feedback without scheduling a full session
bring: A high-quality bounce of the track
Where you plan to release it

name: Mix & Master
summary: Your finished track, mixed and mastered for release.

photos.alt: The stage beside Candy Heist’s booth, a microphone stand in gold light

overview: Your finished track, mixed and mastered for release by a working sound engineer.
Send the stems and a reference. The mix comes back for a round of notes before the master is delivered, ready for streaming and the club.
included: Mix and master of one track
Masters for streaming and club play

howItRuns.title: Kick-off
howItRuns.text: A short call at the time you pick, to hear what you’re after.

howItRuns.title: First mix
howItRuns.text: Built from your stems and reference.

howItRuns.title: Revisions
howItRuns.text: One round of your notes, then the final mix.

howItRuns.title: Delivery
howItRuns.text: Masters for streaming and for the club.

goodFor: A finished track headed for release
Producers who want their mix done by an engineer
bring: Stems, exported from the start of the track
Your release date, if there is one
